summary: member reports, hiding, warnings and mutes with an append-only log
use_when: members report posts, moderators hide them and warn or mute authors
every act logs its actor and reason in one transaction
not_for: automatic content classification, spam or abuse detection: every act here is a moderator's decision
storage, visibility rules, reason vocabulary or notifications: the host owns the tables and binds the Store port itself
blocking logins or deleting accounts: a mute is a record the host reads, this package enforces nothing
